name: check-mermaid
description: Pinned dependencies for scripts/mermaid/check-mermaid.mjs, the CI gate that every mermaid diagram in the repository parses: mermaid parses, marked finds the diagrams (a real CommonMark lexer, not a hand-rolled fence scanner), jsdom supplies the window mermaid's sanitiser needs. Versions are exact on purpose: a floating range would let the parser or the lexer change under the gate between two runs.
